jobPostingInfo.title: Medical Information Specialist with Lithuanian, English and Additional Language
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Role Overview


Use your scientific knowledge and language expertise to join a global team delivering high-quality Medical Information services to healthcare professionals, patients, and consumers. In this role, you will provide accurate, balanced, and non-promotional medical information, supporting customers across multiple communication channels.

As part of the role, you will also identify, document, and route adverse events and product quality complaints in accordance with established safety procedures. The primary focus of this position is Medical Information, with additional support for safety reporting activities.


Key Responsibilities


  • Respond to medical and product-related inquiries received via phone, email, and other approved communication channels.
  • Provide accurate, evidence-based, and non-promotional information regarding products, therapies, and disease areas.
  • Document customer interactions in compliance with company procedures and quality standards.
  • Utilize approved medical information resources and scientific literature to address inquiries.
  • Identify, document, and appropriately route adverse events, product quality complaints, and other reportable information.
  • Support safety data intake activities, including accurate documentation within designated systems.
  • Collaborate with Medical Information, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, and other cross-functional teams
